## Handoff

Record current state, known issues, actual verification results, and unresolved risks
before review. Follow the [module handoff guide](../../docs/DEVELOPMENT_GUIDE.zh-CN.md)
and [operations workflow](../../OPS.md). Only the Tech Lead may merge; this Issue does
not approve unresolved technology choices or work outside its scope.
